_doc: Per-platform posting config for the auto-poster (see PRD: Auto-Post Approved Ads). Keys match config/ad-platforms.json. Only enabled platforms are posted to; the rest stay manual in v1. login_url is where capture-login opens a headed browser for the operator to sign in; new_listing_url is where the posting script starts the listing form. capture selects the login-capture mechanism: 'live-view' (self-hosted streamed browser, see PRD: Self-Hosted Live-View Login Capture) or 'cli' (terminal capture-login ritual; the default when absent). login_success tells live-view capture when the operator has finished logging in: cookie = a cookie name that appears on success, redirect_off = a path the browser leaves on success. URLs for disabled platforms are best-effort placeholders — verify against the live site before enabling. Saved sessions live in workers/posting/auth/<platform>.json (secrets — never expose via the files API or logs). land_com MUST gain a positive cookie signal: its redirect_off-only login_success false-positived on the Akamai Access Denied flow (see the Land.com access spike entry in specs/specs.md). The local poster agent logs the session's cookie NAMES (never values) on every successful login capture — after the first real login on the operator's machine, take land_com's session-cookie name from that log line and add it here as login_success.cookie alongside redirect_off. When both cookie and redirect_off are set, detection requires BOTH (AND) — unit-tested in workers/posting/capture/detect.test.ts.
